Title: WarpSearch for Umbraco Search
Description: Store and search your Umbraco content, media and members in WarpSearch, the serverless hybrid search engine. A drop-in provider for Umbraco Search: full-text relevance tiers, filters, multi-select facets, sorting, culture and segment variants and protected content, with no search cluster to run.
